name: Zhang Zuolin
contribution: A Chinese general, statesman, and warlord who ruled Manchuria from 1916 until his assassination in 1928.
legacy: This person founded the Fengtian clique and gradually expanded his Northeastern Army, which established his supremacy over the three northeastern provinces.

checks.lead: Zhang Zuolin (March 19, 1875 – June 4, 1928) was a Chinese general, statesman, and warlord who ruled Manchuria from 1916 until his assassination in 1928. He led the Fengtian clique, one of the most powerful factions during the Warlord Era. In 1927, he became the leader of the Beiyang government and was declared Generalissimo of the Republic of China.
